starting room.name: Entrance Hall
starting room.description: You find yourself in a dim room with a stone table to your east. You see an unbreakable door with a strong, gilded lock to your west. A single torch on the wall illuminates your path to the north.

corridor.name: Dark Scary Corridor
corridor.description: A torch is mounted on the wall to your right. A large room awaits you to the north.

items.name: Torch
items.description: A stone-shafted torch with a baby flame at the tip

octogon.name: Octogon
octogon.description: A large octogonal-shaped chamber. To the north is a gated pathway.

items.name: Pile of Gold Coins
items.description: A stack of glimmering gold coins

items.name: Monarch's Crown
items.description: A king's crown, with gold plating and jewels lining the bottom

hallway.name: Hallway
hallway.description: A narrow hallway with a room to the north and west.

cellar.name: Wine Cellar
cellar.description: Barrels of wine line the walls, the sweet aroma of finely aged wine fills the air.
